each Classic class has a bounded valid unique collection

for _, class in ipairs({"HUNTER","WARRIOR","ROGUE","MAGE","PRIEST","DRUID","PALADIN","SHAMAN","WARLOCK"}) do
local names, ids, count, starterCount = {}, {}, 0, 0
for _, definition in ipairs(FM.Catalog) do
 if definition.class == "ALL" or definition.class == class then
  assert(not names[definition.name] and not ids[definition.id])
  names[definition.name] = true; ids[definition.id] = true; count = count + 1; if not definition.optional then starterCount = starterCount + 1 end
  local body = assert(FM.Core.Render(definition, function(req) return req.english end))
  assert(#body <= 255 and #definition.name <= 16)
  assert(not body:find("/run", 1, true) and not body:find("/script", 1, true))
 end
end
assert(count >= 8 and starterCount >= 8 and starterCount <= 28)
end

same-body collision arriving after plan is respected

TEST.login(); TEST.learn(136, "Mend Pet")
local snapshot = {macros = {}, characterCount = 0, accountLimit = 120, limit = 30}
local db = FM.Core.NewState(nil)
local plan = FM.Core.Plan(db, "HUNTER", snapshot, function(req) if req.id == 136 then return "Mend Pet" end end)
local writes = 0
FM.Core.Apply(db, plan, {
inCombat = function() return false end, build = "1.60.1", timestamp = function() return 1 end,
snapshot = function() return {macros = {{name = "New personal", body = "/stopcasting\n/stopattack", character = true}}, characterCount = 1, accountLimit = 120, limit = 30} end,
create = function(name) assert(name ~= "FM Stop"); writes = writes + 1; error("stop test") end,
getInfo = GetMacroInfo,
})
assert(writes == 1)
